name: Kane CLI
description: Generates and runs end-to-end tests from a PRD or a natural language description on Chrome, Android and iOS, with evidence packs and coverage for CI gates. For developers and coding agents.

skills.name: Requirement-Linked Tests
skills.description: Turns a PRD, spec or description into use-cases, acceptance criteria, scenarios and runnable _test.md tests through its assurance commands.

skills.name: Web and Mobile Runs
skills.description: Runs tests on desktop Chrome by default, on Android emulators and iOS simulators, and on real Android and iOS devices in the TestMu AI cloud.

skills.name: Evidence and Coverage
skills.description: Seals an evidence pack for every run and measures coverage against acceptance criteria with kane-cli cover.

skills.name: CI Quality Gates
skills.description: Judges an evidence pack against a policy of quality gates with kane-cli evidence verdict to pass or fail a CI run.

skills.name: Agent Mode Output
skills.description: Streams NDJSON output in --agent mode so coding agents can parse results, inspect logs and save replayable test files.

skills.name: Shared Test Projects
skills.description: Links a folder to a shared Test Manager project so a team sees the same use-cases, tests, cases and coverage.
